name: chromodomain helicase DNA binding protein 2

function.text: CHD2 encodes ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler CHD2. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler activity. It participates in nucleosome organization and muscle organ development.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 94 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma; Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
